scanNote:
9-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (64-bet) - GRAMMATIKA.

Yuqorida chapda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '9' va 'A World of Wonders'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Passive (be + past participle)'.
8) a) 'Study the examples and the rules.' b) 'Which sentences in the passive do not include an agent? Why?'
   JADVAL (to'q sariq sarlavhalar 'Active' | 'Passive'):
   They TAKE visitors down into a hidden world. | Visitors ARE TAKEN down into a hidden world.
   The miners CARRIED salt up to the surface. | Salt WAS CARRIED up to the surface by the miners.
   They HAVE MINED salt there for over 700 years. | Salt HAS BEEN MINED there for over 700 years.
   These unforgettable sights WILL AMAZE you. | You WILL BE AMAZED by these unforgettable sights.
   OCh KO'K quti 'Form/Use': • 'To form the passive, we use the appropriate tense of the verb TO BE + THE PAST PARTICIPLE of the main verb.' • 'We use the passive when THE ACTION is more important than THE AGENT (the person or thing doing the action). SALT WAS DISCOVERED. (We are more interested in the action than the person who did it.)'
   OCh KO'K quti 'Changing from Active into Passive': 'The object of an active verb becomes the subject of a passive verb. The subject of an active verb becomes the agent of a passive verb. We usually introduce the agent with BY.' Active: Fire (subject) destroyed (verb) a chapel in 1697 (object). Passive: A chapel (subject) was destroyed (verb) by fire in 1697 (agent).
9) a) 'Read the text on p. 63 again and underline the verbs in the passive, then complete the table.' YaShIL JADVAL: Present Simple (are taken, ...) | Past Simple (were told, ...) | Present Perfect (has been mined, ...) | will/can/should (can be seen, ...)
   b) 'Choose five of the passive verbs in the table and make sentences with them.'

O'NG USTUN:
10) 'Fill in the missing active or passive forms.' TO'Q SARIQ JADVAL 'Active' | 'Passive', 10 qator:
   1 Pollution HAS badly DAMAGED the Sphinx. | The Sphinx ...... badly ...... by pollution.
   2 Visitors SHOULD NOT TOUCH the exhibits. | The exhibits ...... by visitors.
   3 The ancient Egyptians ...... the Pyramids. | The Pyramids WERE BUILT by the ancient Egyptians.
   4 Millions of tourists WILL VISIT the Louvre this year. | The Louvre ...... by millions of tourists this year.
   5 Gustave Eiffel DESIGNED a huge iron tower for Paris. | A huge iron tower ...... for Paris by Gustave Eiffel.
   6 You CAN SEE the Great Wall of China from space. | The Great Wall of China ...... from space.
   7 Tourists sometimes ...... Tower Bridge with London Bridge. | Tower Bridge IS sometimes CONFUSED with London Bridge by tourists.
   8 The Romans COMPLETED the Colosseum in 82 AD. | The Colosseum ...... by the Romans in 82 AD.
   9 People ADMIRE Prague for its lovely buildings. | Prague ...... for its lovely buildings.
   10 Millions of people ...... the Leaning Tower of Pisa. | The Leaning Tower of Pisa HAS BEEN PHOTOGRAPHED by millions of people.
11) 'In pairs, ask and answer questions using the prompts, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: SA: What are these SHOES made of? SB: They're made of LEATHER. SA: Where were they made? SB: They were made in ITALY. What is this RING made of?
   Ko'rsatmalar: • shoes - leather - Italy • ring - gold - France • watch - silver - Switzerland • jacket - wool - Spain | • shirt - silk - China • skirts - cotton - England • toy - plastic - Japan • desks - wood - Germany

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '64'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples and the rules. Passive (be + past participle)
exercises.instructionUz: Misollar va qoidalarni o'rganing. Majhul nisbat (be + 3-shakl)
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL NISBAT - 9-UNITNING ASOSIY
GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TO BE (kerakli zamonda) + 3-ShAKL

  Present Simple:  am/is/are + taken
  Past Simple:     was/were + carried
  Present Perfect: has/have been +
                   mined
  Future:          will be + amazed
  Modal:           can/should be +
                   seen

  ⚠ Zamonni 'BE' ko'rsatadi, asosiy
  fe'l HAR DOIM 3-shaklda.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ACTIVE → PASSIVE                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ACTIVE:  Fire destroyed a chapel.
           (ega)  (fe'l)  (to'ldiruvchi)
  PASSIVE: A chapel was destroyed
           by fire.
           (ega)    (fe'l)   (agent)

  1) Active to'ldiruvchisi →
     passive egasi
  2) Fe'l → be + 3-shakl (zamon
     saqlanadi)
  3) Active egasi → 'by' + agent
     (yoki tushiriladi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QAChON IShLATILADI              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HARAKAT muhim, KIM qilgani muhim
  emas yoki noma'lum:

  'Salt WAS DISCOVERED.'
  (kim topgani muhim emas)

  ⚠ 'by' + agent faqat agent MUHIM
  bo'lganda: 'was destroyed BY FIRE'.


⚠ 8b JAVOBI - AGENTSIZ GAPLAR:

  'Visitors are taken down' - kim
     olib tushishi muhim emas
  'Salt has been mined there' -
     konchilar - aniq, aytish shart
     emas
  ⚠ Agent NOMA'LUM, AhAMIYaTSIZ yoki
  ANIQ bo'lsa tushiriladi.


⚠ O'ZBEKChA BILAN:

  Majhul nisbat o'zbekchada '-il/-in'
  bilan: 'topildi', 'qurilgan',
  'olib tushiladi'.


⚠ 'AN AGENT':

  = harakatni bajaruvchi.
  ⚠ 'the appropriate tense' = mos
  zamon.

points.en: They take visitors down into a hidden world. → Visitors are taken down into a hidden world.
points.uz: Ular tashrif buyuruvchilarni yashirin dunyoga olib tushadi. → Tashrif buyuruvchilar yashirin dunyoga olib tushiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE: are + taken.
⚠ Agent ('they') tushirilgan - muhim emas.

points.en: The miners carried salt up to the surface. → Salt was carried up to the surface by the miners.
points.uz: Konchilar tuzni yuzaga olib chiqardi. → Tuz konchilar tomonidan yuzaga olib chiqarildi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE: was + carried.
⚠ Agent: 'by the miners'.

points.en: They have mined salt there for over 700 years. → Salt has been mined there for over 700 years.
points.uz: Ular u yerda 700 yildan ortiq tuz qazishgan. → U yerda 700 yildan ortiq tuz qazilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT: has been + mined.
⚠ Agent tushirilgan.

points.en: These unforgettable sights will amaze you. → You will be amazed by these unforgettable sights.
points.uz: Bu unutilmas manzaralar sizni hayratga soladi. → Siz bu unutilmas manzaralardan hayratga tushasiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ FUTURE: will be + amazed.
⚠ Agent: 'by these sights'.

points.en: To form the passive, we use the appropriate tense of the verb to be + the past participle of the main verb.
points.uz: Majhul nisbatni yasash uchun 'to be' fe'lining mos zamoni + asosiy fe'lning 3-shaklini ishlatamiz.

points.en: We use the passive when the action is more important than the agent. Salt was discovered.
points.uz: Majhul nisbatni harakat bajaruvchidan muhimroq bo'lganda ishlatamiz. Tuz topildi.

points.en: Active: Fire (subject) destroyed (verb) a chapel in 1697 (object). Passive: A chapel (subject) was destroyed (verb) by fire in 1697 (agent).
points.uz: Aktiv: Yong'in (ega) vayron qildi (fe'l) ibodatxonani (to'ldiruvchi). Majhul: Ibodatxona (ega) vayron qilindi (fe'l) yong'in tomonidan (agent).

exercises.instructionEn: Which sentences in the passive do not include an agent? Why?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi majhul gaplarda agent yo'q? Nima uchun?
exercises.explanationUz:
AGENTSIZ GAPLAR:

  'Visitors are taken down ...'
  'Salt has been mined there ...'

⚠ Sabab: bajaruvchi NOMA'LUM,
AhAMIYaTSIZ yoki KONTEKSTDAN ANIQ
(konchilar). Harakatning o'zi muhim.

items.en: Which sentences in the passive do not include an agent?
items.answerEn: 'Visitors are taken down into a hidden world' and 'Salt has been mined there for over 700 years'.
items.answerUz: 'Visitors are taken down into a hidden world' va 'Salt has been mined there for over 700 years'.

items.answerEn: Because the agent is unknown, unimportant or obvious - we are interested in the action, not in who does it.
items.answerUz: Chunki bajaruvchi noma'lum, ahamiyatsiz yoki aniq - bizni kim qilgani emas, harakatning o'zi qiziqtiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text on p. 63 again and underline the verbs in the passive, then complete the table.
exercises.instructionUz: 63-betdagi matnni qayta o'qing va majhul nisbatdagi fe'llar tagiga chizing, so'ng jadvalni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
63-BETDAGI MATNDAN MAJHUL FE'LLAR:

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
    are taken, are shown

  PAST SIMPLE:
    were told, was discovered, was
    taken out, was found, was
    carried, were used, were killed,
    were injured, were constructed,
    were held, was destroyed, were
    not allowed, was mined, was made

  PRESENT PERFECT:
    has been mined, have been dug
    out, have been carved

  WILL/CAN/SHOULD:
    can be seen, will be amazed,
    should not be missed


⚠ 'USED TO BE DUG' - alohida shakl
  (used to + be + 3-shakl).

pairs.right: were told, was discovered, was taken out, was found, was carried, were used, were killed, were injured, were constructed, were held, was destroyed, were not allowed, was mined, was made
pairs.rightUz: were told, was discovered, ... was made

pairs.right: has been mined, have been dug out, have been carved
pairs.rightUz: has been mined, have been dug out, have been carved

pairs.rightUz: can be seen, will be amazed, should not be missed

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing active or passive forms.
exercises.instructionUz: Tushib qolgan aktiv yoki majhul shakllarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
ACTIVE ↔ PASSIVE - ZAMON SAQLANADI.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 The Sphinx HAS BEEN badly DAMAGED
    by pollution. (present perfect)
  2 The exhibits SHOULD NOT BE
    TOUCHED by visitors. (modal)
  3 The ancient Egyptians BUILT the
    Pyramids. (past simple - aktiv)
  4 The Louvre WILL BE VISITED by
    millions of tourists. (future)
  5 A huge iron tower WAS DESIGNED
    for Paris by Gustave Eiffel.
    (past simple)
  6 The Great Wall of China CAN BE
    SEEN from space. (modal)
  7 Tourists sometimes CONFUSE Tower
    Bridge with London Bridge.
    (present simple - aktiv)
  8 The Colosseum WAS COMPLETED by
    the Romans in 82 AD. (past)
  9 Prague IS ADMIRED for its lovely
    buildings. (present simple)
  10 Millions of people HAVE
    PHOTOGRAPHED the Leaning Tower of
    Pisa. (present perfect - aktiv)


⚠ MAShHUR JOYLAR:

  the Sphinx - Sfinks (Misr)
  the Pyramids - Piramidalar (Misr)
  the Louvre - Luvr muzeyi (Parij)
  the Eiffel Tower - Eyfel minorasi
  the Great Wall of China - Buyuk
     Xitoy devori
  Tower Bridge - London ko'prigi
  the Colosseum - Kolizey (Rim)
  Prague - Praga (Chexiya)
  the Leaning Tower of Pisa -
     Piza minorasi


⚠ 'AD':

  = milodiy (Anno Domini).
  ⚠ 'BC' = miloddan oldingi.


⚠ 'TO CONFUSE A WITH B':

  = A ni B bilan adashtirmoq.


⚠ 'AN EXHIBIT':

  = eksponat (muzeyda).
  ⚠ 'an exhibition' = ko'rgazma.

items.textEn: 1 Pollution has badly damaged the Sphinx. → The Sphinx ___ badly ___ by pollution.
2 Visitors should not touch the exhibits. → The exhibits ___ by visitors.
items.whyUz: ⚠ should not touch → should not BE TOUCHED.

items.textEn: 3 The ancient Egyptians ___ the Pyramids. ← The Pyramids were built by the ancient Egyptians.
items.whyUz:
⚠ were built → BUILT (aktiv).
⚠ build - built - built.

items.textEn: 4 Millions of tourists will visit the Louvre this year. → The Louvre ___ by millions of tourists this year.
5 Gustave Eiffel designed a huge iron tower for Paris. → A huge iron tower ___ for Paris by Gustave Eiffel.
6 You can see the Great Wall of China from space. → The Great Wall of China ___ from space.
items.whyUz:
⚠ can see → can BE SEEN.
⚠ Agent ('you') tushiriladi.

items.textEn: 7 Tourists sometimes ___ Tower Bridge with London Bridge. ← Tower Bridge is sometimes confused with London Bridge by tourists.
8 The Romans completed the Colosseum in 82 AD. → The Colosseum ___ by the Romans in 82 AD.
9 People admire Prague for its lovely buildings. → Prague ___ for its lovely buildings.
10 Millions of people ___ the Leaning Tower of Pisa. ← The Leaning Tower of Pisa has been photographed by millions of people.
items.whyUz:
⚠ has been photographed → HAVE PHOTOGRAPHED
(aktiv, 'people' ko'plik → have).

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions using the prompts, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: What are these shoes made of?
  SB: They're made of leather.
  SA: Where were they made?
  SB: They were made in Italy.


⚠ 'TO BE MADE OF':

  = ... dan yasalgan (material).
  ⚠ 'made OF leather' - 'of'
  predlogi.


⚠ 'TO BE MADE IN':

  = ... da ishlab chiqarilgan
  (davlat).
  ⚠ 'Made in Italy' - mahsulot
  yorlig'i.


⚠ SAVOL ShAKLLARI:

  'What IS this ring made of?'
     (birlik)
  'What ARE these shoes made of?'
     (ko'plik)
  'Where WAS it made?' / 'Where
   WERE they made?'


⚠ MATERIALLAR:

  leather - teri
  gold - oltin
  silver - kumush
  wool - jun
  silk - ipak
  cotton - paxta
  plastic - plastmassa
  wood - yog'och

items.question: SA: What are these shoes made of? — SB: They're made of leather. — SA: Where were they made?
items.answer: SB: They were made in Italy.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi namuna.
⚠ 'made OF' - material, 'made IN' - davlat.

items.question: SA: What is this ring made of? — SB: It's made of gold. — SA: Where was it made?
items.answer: SB: It was made in France.

items.question: SA: What is this shirt made of? — SB: It's made of silk. — SA: Where was it made?
items.answer: SB: It was made in China.

items.question: SA: What are these skirts made of? — SB: They're made of cotton. — SA: Where were they made?
items.answer: SB: They were made in England.

items.question: SA: What is this toy made of? — SB: It's made of plastic. — SA: Where was it made?
items.answer: SB: It was made in Japan.

items.question: SA: What are these desks made of? — SB: They're made of wood. — SA: Where were they made?
items.answer: SB: They were made in Germany.

patterns.exampleEn: Prague is admired for its lovely buildings.
patterns.exampleUz: Praga go'zal binolari uchun sevib tomosha qilinadi.

patterns.exampleEn: The Pyramids were built by the ancient Egyptians.
The Great Wall of China can be seen from space.

patterns.formula: What is/are [nima] made of? - It's/They're made of [material]. Where was/were it/they made? - In [davlat].
patterns.exampleEn: What are these shoes made of? - They're made of leather. Where were they made? - They were made in Italy.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu oyoq kiyim nimadan yasalgan? - Teridan. Qayerda ishlab chiqarilgan? - Italiyada.
